description: Manage task lists and tasks in Google Tasks.

google_tasks_new_task_list_trigger.description: Runs when a task list is added to your Google Tasks. Lists already there when the workflow is turned on don't start it. How often it checks follows your workspace plan.

output.id: The task list's ID, for steps that take one.
output.title: The task list's name.

google_tasks_new_task_trigger.description: Runs for each new task in a Google Tasks list, with its title, notes and due date. Tasks already there when the workflow is turned on don't start it. Watches lists of up to 4,000 open tasks. How often it checks follows your workspace plan.

output.completed: When it was completed (RFC 3339), empty while open.
output.due: When it is due (RFC 3339), empty if it has no due date.
output.id: The task's ID, for Update task or Complete task.
output.parent: The task it sits under, empty for a top-level task.
output.status: needsAction while open, completed once done.
output.task_list_id: The task list it is in.
output.title: The task's title.
output.url: Link that opens the task in Google Tasks.

parameters.description: The task list to watch. Pick one, or give its ID from an earlier step.
parameters.name: task_list_id

google_tasks_task_completed_trigger.description: Runs when a task in a Google Tasks list is marked done. Tasks done before the workflow is turned on don't start it. How often it checks follows your workspace plan.

output.completed: When it was completed (RFC 3339), empty while open.
output.due: When it is due (RFC 3339), empty if it has no due date.
output.id: The task's ID, for Update task or Complete task.
output.parent: The task it sits under, empty for a top-level task.
output.status: needsAction while open, completed once done.
output.task_list_id: The task list it is in.
output.title: The task's title.
output.url: Link that opens the task in Google Tasks.

parameters.description: The task list to watch. Pick one, or give its ID from an earlier step.
parameters.name: task_list_id
